items.hed: Yordan Alvarez won the American League Most Valuable Player Award unanimously, becoming only the third Astro to win MVP, and the Astros were also named MLB's Team of the Year
items.insight: Alvarez took all 30 first-place votes from the Baseball Writers' Association of America, joining Jeff Bagwell (1994 NL) and Jose Altuve (2017 AL) as the only Astros MVPs, according to MLB.com. He led the American League in batting average (.316), on-base percentage (.432), slugging (.601), OPS (1.033), offensive WAR, total bases and walks, and finished second in RBIs with 106 and tied for second in home runs with 42, both career highs. Junior Caminero of the Rays finished second in the voting and Bobby Witt Jr. of the Royals was third. Alvarez also won his second career Silver Slugger Award at designated hitter, and the Astros were named MLB's Team of the Year after leading the American League with 226 home runs.

items.hed: Five Colts starters are already ruled out ahead of Thursday night's game at Houston, including cornerback Charvarius Ward and tackle Bernhard Raimann, per the official injury report
items.insight: The club's injury report shows Indianapolis has already ruled out tackle Jalen Travis (knee), tackle Bernhard Raimann (concussion), defensive tackle Jerry Tillery (calf), tight end Will Mallory (hamstring) and cornerback Charvarius Ward (knee) for Thursday night's Week 11 game at Houston. Cornerback Sauce Gardner (calf) and long snapper Luke Rhodes (hamstring) are questionable after sitting out practice earlier in the week. The Texans and Colts kick off Thursday, Nov. 19, at Houston.

items.hed: Houston closes out a three-game road trip tonight at Indiana, looking to bounce back after splitting a win at Washington and a loss at Miami earlier this week
items.insight: The Rockets' official schedule lists tonight's game at Gainbridge Fieldhouse tipping off at 7 p.m. ET, following a 147-119 win at Washington on Nov. 15 and a 110-128 loss at Miami on Nov. 16. The result was not yet final at this writing. Houston's next game after Indiana is at Denver on Friday.
